title: Executive sales comparison source-readiness diagnostic
what_to_watch: Executive net_sales for the latest reported month versus the prior calendar month, with channel contribution to total movement.
why_watch: Prepare a reusable sales check without mistaking an incomplete reporting month for a business decline.
questions: Does the Executive daily model establish full coverage of both calendar months?
For comparable complete months, how did total net_sales change and how much did each channel contribute?
decision_guidance: The Executive net_sales model is the official management sales figure, not GAAP revenue or settled cash. The historical owner's coverage declaration applies only to Executive daily reporting: all dates through its latest order_date are complete, including earlier calendar months. Verify this cutoff rather than using request time. If the latest reported month is partial or coverage cannot be established, use insufficient_data for that comparison, proposed to Data Trust. Still explain the latest two fully covered months if supported. On a complete comparable primary comparison, a net-sales decline of at least 15 percent means notify Leadership; otherwise an absolute change of at least 10 percent means investigate with Analytics; smaller movements mean ignore. Channel detail explains the total, not extra alerts. Do not combine marketing-attributed revenue with Executive net_sales or infer causes from correlation. No messages or scheduling are authorized.
